text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo. A new day dawns in Palermo without Haiku. Haiku's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the citizen, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the killer, Sol the killer, Luna the officer, Terra the doctor.

Luna claimed to be the officer and named Sol as a killer, but the town voted her out on the first day and never checked her claim. Terra was lost before the second day, and Gemma was voted out after dodging every request for a real read. Haiku fell in the night before the end, which left Sol and Gemma, the two hidden killers, standing. Sonnet and Haiku later said they should have trusted Luna sooner, and Sol got away with it. The killers won.
